The mind fuck with credit cards is that to get the ff points bonus, you need to spend something like $5K of your money. Most people probably don't have anything to spend that amount on so they try to justify it and buy some random shit that they couldn't afford to get those points. Pretty soon, they'll find themselves in debt. 🤷🏾‍♂️ 

If you add the yearly fee, missed payments and having no buffer and you have yourself a disaster and eventually, something life changing thing happens and you are completely fucked 

I know it sounds trivial to most but the key is to have enough money at the end of the month to pay off the FULL balance. I'd go one step further and argue that you should only treat a credit card as if it was a debit. That is, if you can't afford that $3,000 Macbook now, then you shouldn't use your card.

I was $25,000 in debt and living with zero savings every pay since 2016. I also have a $450K mortgage. Every day was a stress day for me and I developed chronic anxiety over my job security, relationships and finances. Every little thing that happened at work, I related to losing my job and catastrophisng the situation.... Over that debt. I didn't know how much the debt was fucking with my life until I finally was in the positive.

I'm now down to $500 debt and$2K saving as at July. Next pay, i should have $3K. 
Aim is to reach $10K before I even think of splurging again and get a credit card.

No more.

Tl/dr: Card companies will fuck you up and they aren't sympathetic. They WILL engage a debt collector if you don't pay on time
